customManagers.description: Chart appVersion annotated with Renovate hints
Pinned CI tool versions annotated with Renovate hints

packageRules.description: appVersion and pinned CI tool versions are plain strings, not image references -- never append a digest
SearXNG publishes date-stamped tags with a git SHA suffix; the SHA is not orderable, so it is matched but excluded from comparison

Automerge only CI tool pins. Chart appVersion and subchart bumps are deliberately excluded: chart-releaser publishes on Chart.yaml version and skips versions it has already released, so an automerged chart edit would land without ever being published

ct lint requires a chart version bump on every chart change and chart-releaser publishes on chart version, so an appVersion-only PR can never be released. The regex is deliberately unanchored: Renovate compiles matchStrings without the multiline flag, so ^ would mean start-of-file and never match. It still picks the chart version because apiVersion has a capital V and exec() without /g returns the first hit, which precedes any dependency version.
